intro.what: Ushbu mavzuda ko'plikdagi otlar bilan 'bir nechta' (some) va 'hech qanday' (any) so'zlarining ishlatilishi hamda buyumlarning joyini bildiruvchi predloglarni o'rganamiz.
when: Darak gaplarda 'bir nechta' narsa borligini aytishda 'some' ishlatiladi.
Inkor gaplarda 'hech qanday' narsa yo'qligini aytishda 'any' ishlatiladi.
So'roq gaplarda 'birorta' narsa bor-yo'qligini bilish uchun 'any' ishlatiladi.
Narsalarning qayerda (ustida, ichida, tagida, yonida) ekanligini ko'rsatishda joy predloglari ishlatiladi.

structures.formula: There are + some + plural noun + preposition + place
structures.example_en: There are some books on the desk.
structures.example_uz: Parta ustida bir nechta kitoblar bor.

structures.example_en: There aren't any chairs in the room.
Are there any photos on the wall?

structures.label: Prepositions
structures.formula: [Subject] + is/are + in / on / under / next to + [Object]
structures.example_en: The cat is under the table.

rules.title: Some va Any qo'llanilishi
rules.text: Some faqat darak gaplarda, any esa inkor va so'roq gaplarda ko'plikdagi otlar bilan ishlatiladi.

rules.title: Next to va Near farqi
rules.text: Next to - yonma-yon, juda yaqin (orasida masofa yo'q). Near - yaqinida (biroz masofa bo'lishi mumkin).

examples.en: The lamp is next to the bed.
There is a park near my house.

mistakes.why: Inkor gaplarda 'some' ishlatib bo'lmaydi, 'any' bo'lishi kerak.

mistakes.wrong: The keys are in the table.
mistakes.right: The keys are on the table.
mistakes.why: Kalitlar stolning ichida emas, ustida bo'ladi.

test.q: There aren't ______ apples in the fridge.

test.q: The bus station is ______ the cinema.

test.q: Is there a TV ______ the bedroom?

test.q: There are ______ children in the park today.

test.q: There isn't ______ coffee in the cup.

test.q: The hotel is ______ the station.
test.explain: Mehmonxona stansiyaning yonida bo'lsa 'next to' ishlatiladi.

test.q: Are there ______ letters for me?
test.explain: So'roq gapda ko'plikdagi otlar bilan 'any' ishlatiladi.
